**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Wait for the promoted Kompas PRO instead of the removed pilot**

In the inspected `cn-site-v2-gate.yml`, this test runs after `promote-root.mjs`, which promotes `next/unified.html` using `promoteUnifiedHtml()`. That transformer explicitly rejects `id="official-product-pilot"` and requires `compass-pro` instead (`premium-v2/promote-root.mjs:82–93,132–135`). Consequently, this wait times out at every viewport on a correctly built root, making the existing mandatory product gate fail and preventing successful screenshots or axe audits. Target the actual promoted component and update its source-state readback accordingly.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Activate the graph tab before measuring or interacting with it**

Even after correcting the obsolete pilot selector, navigation to the hashless root leaves the graph hidden: `premium-v2/premium-tabs.mjs:124–129,166` defaults to the Compass tab and sets every other panel's `hidden` property. Thus `#chart.getBoundingClientRect()` returns zero dimensions and this assertion rejects the healthy page at all four widths; the subsequent BTC/ETH clicks and graph screenshots also require that hidden panel to be revealed. Click `[data-premium-nav="graph"]` and wait for the graph to become visible before graph measurements and interactions, while capturing the default Compass view separately if needed.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Audit the default Compass view before hiding it**

At every viewport, this audit runs only after activating the graph tab. `premium-tabs.mjs` hides the other panels, and `premium-tabs.css` applies `display:none!important` to hidden tab panels, so axe excludes the default `#compass-pro` view, PATH and Proof from its accessibility checks. Consequently, accessibility regressions in the primary landing view cannot appear in the report, and `NO_AUTOMATED_VIOLATIONS` can be reported despite violations there. Run axe on the default Compass view before switching tabs and aggregate results for each audited view, explicitly identifying any unaudited views.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Wait for each asset refresh before capturing graph evidence**

When an asset's feed request has not completed before the next browser operation, these clicks and screenshots race the renderer. In `premium-v2/graph-b/source-graph-b.mjs`, the click handler starts asynchronous `refresh()`, which immediately clears `model` and the plotted paths before fetching the feeds; the subsequent BTC refresh also invalidates any pending ETH result through `requestGeneration`. Playwright's `click()` does not await that refresh, so the test can skip the rendered ETH state and capture a temporarily empty BTC chart while still reporting functional PASS, since its graph assertions ran before either click. Wait for each selected asset's refresh to settle into a source-bound or explicitly unavailable state, verify the selected asset, and only then continue or capture screenshots.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Exclude lagged windows from complete-cutoff census counts**

When the source lacks an as-of-eligible candle ending at a grid cutoff, `assess` can reuse a window ending up to three hours earlier, but the census counts it as another complete cutoff and potentially another candidate. Regression fixture: `replay_census(fixture(), "2026-10-30T19:00:00Z")` returns four eligible cutoffs and four candidates, although the fixture ends at 16:00Z; its cluster repeats that single event four times. At exact HEAD `44cd8f29dc3340676871cdeb7d2cdeb2902b332f`, all 101 gate tests pass, but the eight-file public replay's reported 167 eligible cutoffs include 59 whose evidence ends before their evaluation cutoff.
